title: StackChan K151 camera upgrade feasibility (GC0308 -> OV2640/OV3660/OV5640)

hardware.notes: No physical unit available; no J2 continuity, rail, reset or lens measurements

firmware.camera_path: esp_video 2.5.0 + esp_cam_sensor 2.6.0, GC0308 DVP 8-bit, YUV422 320x240@20, SCCB 100kHz

execution.environment: macOS; read-only source, published schematic text and official docs; local Device Service profile query only (no session)

questions: Can M5Stack provide the camera/sensor sub-board schematic, complete 24-pin FPC pinout and power rail specifications?
Is enabling the existing GC0308 VGA mode sufficient for 640x480, or are capture pipeline and buffer changes required?
followup.evidence_class: code-level verification for the StackChan esp_video path; separate virtual-device data point for GC0308 VGA on AtomS3R-CAM (esp32-camera path)
limits: No K151 hardware; J2 continuity, rail current and thermal NOT RUN
StackChan virtual-device VGA NOT RUN: the model attaches m5_lcd_cam at fixed 320x240 and the GC0308 geometry binding is wired only for AtomS3R-CAM
No VGA build, flash, PSRAM high-water or audio-concurrency measurement
Sub-board pinout, BOM and per-rail limits remain unpublished
